cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(c_family_macos_fixture LANGUAGES CXX OBJCXX)
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)
add_library(overlay STATIC overlay.cc overlay_mac.mm)
target_include_directories(overlay PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
target_compile_definitions(overlay PRIVATE OVERLAY_FEATURE=1)
add_executable(overlay_test overlay_test.cc)
target_include_directories(overlay_test PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
target_compile_definitions(overlay_test PRIVATE OVERLAY_FEATURE=1)
